questions.question: The LORD told the prophet Hosea to marry a prostitute and have children of adultery. What reason did He give?

answers.text: The land was departing from the LORD
Hosea had been hiding from the LORD
The kings had stopped praying to the LORD

questions.question: Through the prophet Hosea, the LORD said He would bring bloodshed on the house of Jehu. Which kingdom would He also end?
The LORD told Hosea He would save the people of Judah. How would they be saved?

answers.text: By bow and sword in battle

questions.question: The LORD told Hosea to name his son Lo-ammi because the people were not His people and He was not their God. True or false?
